reply: You can check our customer service hours in **Settings → Help → Contact us** or at [nimbuscrm.example/support-hours](https://nimbuscrm.example/support-hours). Live chat and phone support are available **Monday–Friday, 8:00–20:00 (GMT)**. Email support is answered 24/7.

priority_reason: Asking how to get a refund (base level M).
reply: To request a refund, log in to your account and go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. Next to the relevant invoice, click **Request refund**. If you need further assistance, let us know the invoice number, and we’ll help.

priority_reason: Question about payment methods (base level L).
reply: Nimbus CRM accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and PayPal for all plans. Bank transfers (wire/ACH) are available only for annual plans of $5,000 or more. Cheques and cryptocurrency are not supported. You can update your payment method in **Settings → Billing → Payment method**.

priority_reason: Customer is blocked from using the product due to a sign-up error (base level H).
reply: If you’re encountering an error during sign-up, you can notify us directly by contacting support with a screenshot of the error. Our team will investigate and help resolve it as quickly as possible. You can reach us via email at **support@nimbuscrm.example** or use the chat widget in the app during live hours (Mon–Fri, 8:00–20:00 GMT).

priority_reason: Asking about refund status or a problem with a refund qualifies as High priority if there is a perceived issue ('rebates of my money' implies a refund is expected but not received or disputed).
reply: I see you’re looking to request a refund. Could you share the invoice number or confirm if you’ve already submitted a refund request? Refunds are processed within 5 business days after approval, and you can track the status in **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. If you haven’t requested one yet, you can do so directly in the app or let me know, and I’ll guide you.

priority_reason: Customer needs to update account details, but isn't blocked and nothing is at risk.
reply: To update your Platinum account details, go to **Settings → Profile** in your Nimbus CRM workspace. Here, you can edit your name, email, or company details. If you’re changing your email, you’ll need to confirm the update from both your old and new addresses. Let us know if you need further assistance!

priority_reason: Formal complaint lodging is a high-priority churn signal per the rubric.
reply: You can lodge a formal complaint at **nimbuscrm.example/complaints** or by emailing **complaints@nimbuscrm.example**. Every complaint receives a reference number, an acknowledgement within **2 business days**, and a written response within **10 business days**. If you need further assistance, let me know.
